sentences: In a diagnostic setting where the forecast day's weather is known, short-timescale weather explains part of the day-to-day variation in AQI beyond seasonal climatology (MAE 4.9% lower, 90% interval 3.6 to 6.2), and it adds to the weather of the forecast origin.
Weather known at the forecast origin also lowers the error beyond seasonal climatology (MAE 3.4% lower, 90% interval 1.4 to 5.3).
